merge.title: Merge PDF
merge.desc: Join multiple files into one, arranged in your own order.

split.title: Split PDF
split.desc: Cut by page ranges into a new file or several files.

extract.title: Extract pages
extract.desc: Pick exactly the pages you need and export them.

remove.title: Delete pages
remove.desc: Drop extra pages and preview the result right away.

reorder.title: Reorder pages
reorder.desc: Drag thumbnails to rearrange the page order.

rotate.title: Rotate pages
rotate.desc: Rotate selected pages by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.

fill-form.title: Fill PDF forms
fill-form.desc: Fill Vietnamese text fields, forms stay interactive.

compress.title: Compress PDF
compress.desc: Smaller file size with text quality kept intact.

pdf-to-img.title: PDF to images
pdf-to-img.desc: Export each page as a high-quality JPG or PNG.

img-to-pdf.title: Images to PDF
img-to-pdf.desc: Combine images into one A4 PDF file.

metadata.title: File info
metadata.desc: View and edit title, author, and keywords.

sign.title: Sign document
sign.desc: Draw, type, or upload a signature onto the page.

ocr.title: OCR (text recognition)
ocr.desc: Turn scans into a searchable PDF + extractable text (Vietnamese/English), fully on-device

watermark.title: Watermark
watermark.desc: Stamp text or images onto selected pages — position, angle, tiled.
watermark.remove_hint_placeholder: Type the exact watermark text (e.g. DRAFT)
watermark.remove_note: Files stamped by PDF Toolkit are removed exactly via metadata. Files stamped by other tools: matched by the text above — best effort, may not remove everything.
watermark.remove_done_tagged: Done. Watermark removed exactly (PDF Toolkit metadata).
watermark.remove_done_heuristic: Done. Watermark removed by text matching (not stamped by PDF Toolkit).
watermark.remove_err_not_found: No matching watermark found. Check the watermark text.
watermark.remove_err_hint: This file has no PDF Toolkit metadata — enter the watermark text to attempt removal.
watermark.err_crashed: The PDF engine just crashed and is ready to restart.
watermark.err_crashed_detail: The operation did not complete and will not re-run automatically — press Retry to run it again.

page-numbers.title: Page numbers
page-numbers.desc: Add page numbers with token templates — 4 presets, skip-first supported.
